scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Persons With Special Needs
other_conditions: Resident of Delhi for at least 5 years before application
Disability certificate must be issued by the Medical Board of a Government hospital
Applicant must have a single‑operated bank or post office account for electronic clearing
Relaxations may be given to minors, mentally challenged applicants, or those under legal guardianship as per National Trust rules
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of Rs 2500 per month until the age of 60.
